title: Pilot Declares Emergency Because Of Extreme Hypoxia
summary: Air traffic audio of a pilot slurring and incoherent while declaring an emergency due to extreme hypoxia, with controllers at Cleveland Center struggling to understand him.
why: Cited as an audible example of what hypoxia sounds like and how consciousness fades gradually.

quote.text: listen to the incoherency of this professional pilot suffering effects of hypoxia at 32,000 feet
